card.title: EL ALAMEIN
card.text: El Alamein was the furthest the Afrikakorps got in Egypt.
card.flavorText: El Alamein (Arabic: The two flags) is a town in the North of Egypt where two major WWII battles were fought between the Axis, under the command of Rommel, and the Allied forces in the Western Desert Campaign. The First Battle of El Alamein (1–27 July 1942) ended in a stalemate, but the Allies managed to halt the Axis advance on Alexandria. The Second Battle of El Alamein (23 October – 11 November 1942) ended in a decisive Allied victory and broke the grip the Axis had on North Africa.
